mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_restrictions (user_id, type, until, reason) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{until}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, until, reason, created_at FROM user_restrictions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = #{type} AND (until IS NULL OR until > NOW()) ORDER BY (until IS NULL) DESC, until DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, type, until, reason, created_at FROM user_restrictions WHERE until IS NULL OR until > NOW() ORDER BY user_id, until
mapper.update: UPDATE user_restrictions SET until = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (until IS NULL OR until > NOW())
